integrity_notes: The polyhedral cut, reflection criterion, all parameter regimes, and complete center-locus classification are established by a self-contained argument. Bibliographic novelty remains subject to independent source assessment; no external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: One forbidden vertex of a rank-k hypersimplex, with rank and corank each at least three; it does not classify arbitrary deleted-vertex patterns, sparse-paving matroids, or Euclidean center invariants. Finite exact-rational experiments corroborate but do not prove the general result.
title: One forbidden hypersimplex vertex: exact asymmetry and a simplex of centers
